adaptations: Legacy identity/password/session/role/permission/storage infrastructure maps to native platform APIs, never duplicate tables.
Credential-valued legacy columns omitted; use Taruvi native secrets and private server operations.
All business IDs and native-user references use UUID; quantities retain source integer/decimal types.
New business FK deletes use RESTRICT, or SET NULL where source nullable, to avoid cascaded business data deletion.
Existing four resources retain every live field/type/default/index/FK; organizations gets optional missing noncredential fields.
Cycle FKs are added only after both tables exist.
Workflow locks use UUID id plus unique organization_id; no locking behavior is claimed.
JSON source columns use any to preserve both array and object values.
Dynamic legacy index-only maintenance not replayed: all new FKs and parsed explicit business indexes are indexed.
